items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: maybe me and Creed Taylor were the only two people who were like really chasing commercial records.

ctx.x: No, this we need a hit, you know.

Well because the guys that I recorded I thought were capable of having hits. Listen. I’m not going to out-Blue Note Blue Note. I’m not going to out-Verve Verve, and I’m not going to out-Prestige Prestige. They did something. I wanted to make records with guys who you call jazz musicians who I think could sell records and not lose their jazz chops. So I wasn’t the first or the only guy but I was — maybe me and Creed Taylor were the only two people who were like really chasing commercial records. Because he had…
So do you say to him, because you’re not a composer —
